decisions.mark: names mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque as the primitive that stops the compiler from knowing a value, and locates it in library/constant_time_impl.h
decisions.detail: QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque` (`:85`) hides the value from the optimiser. With assembly it is `asm volatile("" : [x] "+r" (x))`... This stops the compiler from folding a known constant into a branch. | WHY: The answer names mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque as the primitive hiding values from the compiler and places it in `library/constant_time_impl.h` (line 85).

decisions.mark: explains that the asm path is an EMPTY asm volatile statement with the value as an input-output register operand — it emits no instruction and exists solely as an optimisation barrier
decisions.detail: QUOTE: With assembly it is `asm volatile("" : [x] "+r" (x))`. Without it, it is `x ^ mbedtls_ct_zero`... | WHY: The answer states the asm path is an empty `asm volatile("")` with x as a "+r" in/out operand, and says it hides the value from the optimiser, which covers the optimisation-barrier purpose.

decisions.mark: states that when assembly is unavailable the SAME function falls back to XOR-ing with an extern volatile global that holds zero, and identifies that global
decisions.detail: QUOTE: Without it, it is `x ^ mbedtls_ct_zero`, where `mbedtls_ct_zero` is a `volatile` global (`library/constant_time.c:29`). | WHY: The answer says that without assembly `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque` XORs with the `volatile` global `mbedtls_ct_zero`, so it names both the fallback and the global.

decisions.mark: states that MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is DERIVED rather than configured — it is set from MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM together with compiler predefined macros, not from an entry in mbedtls_config.h
decisions.detail: QUOTE: The base gate is `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM`, which defaults on (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:52`). The compiler and CPU must also match `__GNUC__` or `__ARMCC_VERSION` and `__x86_64__`/`__amd64__` and so on (`constant_time_impl.h:40–52`). | WHY: The answer describes MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus compiler macros gating the asm, but it never says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is derived rather than configured.
